shared.style: calm editorial still-life photography. One broad source of cool north-facing daylight entering from the side, throwing soft-edged shadows with long clean gradients. A palette of warm bone and off-white against cool pale grey shade, nothing saturated anywhere. Deep focus, so the subject is sharp and plainly recognisable and fills a good part of the frame, standing on a bare uncluttered pale surface with quiet space around it. Matte plaster, uncoated paper and pale wood, fine photographic grain, restrained documentary realism.
